description.zh: 用英文讲清经历、动机与岗位匹配度
description.en: Explain your background, motivation, and fit

line.text: Thanks for making the time. Tell me a bit about yourself.
line.translation: 谢谢你抽时间。先简单介绍一下你自己吧。

next_lines.text: I've been building backend services for five years, mostly in Rust.
next_lines.translation: 我做后端开发五年了，主要使用 Rust。

next_lines.text: Recently, I led a migration that reduced our API latency by 30%.
next_lines.translation: 最近我负责了一次迁移，让 API 延迟降低了 30%。

line.text: Thanks for hopping on the call. Could you walk me through your background?
line.translation: 谢谢你上线。能简单讲讲你的经历吗？

next_lines.text: I started in payments and moved into platform engineering.
next_lines.translation: 我从支付业务起步，后来转到了平台工程。

next_lines.text: For the last five years I've focused on backend services.
next_lines.translation: 过去五年我一直专注后端服务。

line.text: Great to meet you. Why don't you start with a quick intro?
line.translation: 很高兴认识你。你先简单介绍一下自己吧？

next_lines.text: Sure, I'm a backend engineer with five years of experience.
next_lines.translation: 好，我是一名有五年经验的后端工程师。

next_lines.text: I currently lead a small team building internal platforms.
next_lines.translation: 我目前在带一个小团队做内部平台。

guidance: 扮演 HR 初筛面试官。关注用户能否用 60-90 秒讲清经历主线、为什么这个岗位、                   为什么这家公司；回答空泛时追问 "What specifically attracted you to this role?"。
